abstract: Gene model for the ortholog of raptor in the May 2011 (Agencourt Dere_CAF1/DereCAF1) Genome Assembly (GenBank Accession: GCA_000005135.1) of Drosophila erecta. This ortholog was characterized as part of a developing dataset to study the evolution of the Insulin/insulin-like growth factor signaling pathway (IIS) across the genus Drosophila using the Genomics Education Partnership gene annotation protocol for Course-based Undergraduate Research Experiences.
